_readme: Component inventory decomposed from opt_bcplus_v8's 11 evaluated members (seed + iter_001..010).
Hand-audited against the candidate sources on 2026-07-29; every claim is checkable by diffing
the named files. `members` is the member x component 0/1 matrix; `params` records the per-member
settings of a parameterised component. `assemblies` re-expresses each member as slot assignments —
the retro-fitted configs that become real assembly files once the executor gains an assembler.
Known confounds are listed in `confounds`: attribution must treat those sets as bundles.

slots.research_prompt: system prompt of the main investigator node
slots.decoding: temperature / thinking settings of the investigator
slots.cutoff_rail: hard research deadline: onTurn inject + preToolUse block
slots.closure: how a deadline-hitting run is converted into an answer
slots.output_contract: how the final answer leaves the workflow

prompt.seed_persistent.desc: seed's generic persistent-researcher prompt: vary keywords, reformulate, commit before turns run out

prompt.evidence_lead.desc: upgraded investigator: rarest-clue anchoring, private candidate ledger, abandon weak query families, stop on decisive clues, exact answer-shape rules (full names, date granularity), never finish empty

variants.one_line_only: iter_003: entire final response must be exactly one line

prompt.bounded_researcher.desc: iter_002: sole-researcher variant emphasising resolve-the-requested-value (not a related clue) and immediate submit_result

prompt.scout_resolver_pair.desc: iter_004: scout prompt (fast anchor, dossier handoff) + resolver prompt (verify dossier, resolve remaining links)

decode.greedy_nothink.desc: temperature 0 + thinkingLevel 'off'. NOTE: with reasoning:false pi drops thinkingLevel, so thinking stays at the server default — the effective change is temperature only

rail.cutoff.desc: onTurn inject 'research closed, answer now' + preToolUse block from the deadline turn

closure.post_editor.desc: unconditional second node after the lead returns: tool-free exact-answer editor over the report tail (8k chars), schema {answer}; falls back to raw report

closure.inhook_editor.desc: conditional closure spawned INSIDE onTurn at the deadline: tool-free schema editor over the recent transcript window; on success stops the lead (stop:true) — early finishers never pay for it

out.schema_direct.desc: the investigator itself is schema-bound ({answer, minLength 1}); no separate finalisation

out.regex_extractor.desc: deterministic extractExactAnswer: last 'Final answer:' line, markdown stripped; accepts any non-empty string (no answer-shape validation)

verify.exact_name.desc: iter_006: predicate-gated (question asks full/real/baptismal name) 4-turn verifier with tools; word-count guard never shortens the lead's answer

rail.starvation_close.desc: iter_008: counts open_doc calls; at turn 48 with <=1 opened document, closes research early (evidence-starved branch only)

topo.scout_resolver.desc: iter_004: two sequential tool-bearing nodes (scout 25t -> dossier -> resolver 33t) instead of a single lead

assemblies._desc: each member re-expressed as slot assignments (null = slot empty)

confounds: rail.cutoff is present in EVERY non-seed member: its effect is only measurable against the seed and is confounded with 'was optimised at all'
closure.inhook_editor always co-occurs with {out.regex_extractor, decode.greedy_nothink, prompt.evidence_lead} — isolate via iter_005/006 (extractor without closure, default decode)
topo.scout_resolver == prompt.scout_resolver_pair == {iter_004}: a singleton bundle, no within-run attribution possible
verify.exact_name == {iter_006} and rail.starvation_close == {iter_008}: singleton components; their effect estimate is one member's delta vs its nearest neighbour (iter_005 / iter_007 respectively)
out.schema_direct == {iter_002, iter_004}: both also carry decode.greedy_nothink
